trigger.root_cause: The MVP branch passport encoded an unstarted runtime with the nonempty sentinel NOT_STARTED. PC0 correctly interprets every nonempty tested_heads.runtime value as a Git revision and therefore fails closed when NOT_STARTED cannot resolve.

repair: Use the existing PC0 representation for an untested active runtime frontier: empty tested-head fields. This produces RUNTIME_TEST_PENDING/YELLOW without claiming a runtime PASS or weakening PC0 SHA validation.
stop_conditions: Any runtime-tested SHA must be invented before a real runtime test exists
notes: This is post-ACT0 control hygiene only. It does not authorize MVP runtime mutation by itself; the exact-main epoch audit remains required before MVP1 implementation.
